equation: xdot_i = x_i * ((A x)_i - x^T A x)

integrator.method: fixed-step RK4, projected onto the simplex each step

sampling.interior: symmetric Dirichlet(1) — uniform ON the simplex, not normalised uniform draws (which concentrate at the centre)
sampling.vertices: all N monocultures, counted separately from the basin fractions (a measure-zero set)

unconverged_policy: a trajectory that does not reach the tolerance is NEVER assigned to an attractor; it is counted in n_unconverged. Cyclic games (e.g. rock-paper-scissors) legitimately produce mostly unconverged runs, which is a finding, not a failure.
